resources.string: PullDock brings torrents and authorized media into one quiet, predictable queue.
Your files stay on this device. Here is what happens on the network, and what you are responsible for.
PullDock asks for the minimum permissions required to run transfers and show progress.

By continuing, you acknowledge that torrent transfers expose your IP address to peers, that you will only download content you have the right to download, and that PullDock is local-first with no accounts or analytics.
PullDock downloads BitTorrent transfers and authorized media from supported providers, manages both in one queue, and plays finished media in-app. It does not search for or index content.
Everything stays on this device: your downloads, your library, your settings. PullDock has no accounts, no analytics, and no upload path.
BitTorrent transfers connect directly to other peers. During a torrent transfer, your IP address is visible to those peers — this is how the protocol works and cannot be avoided while transferring.
You are responsible for downloading only content you have the right to download. PullDock does not bypass DRM, paywalls, login walls, or private accounts, and it will not attempt to.

Notifications: progress and control of running downloads (Android 13+, optional — the app works without it). File access is handled through the system file picker and scoped storage only. No clipboard reading, no location, no contacts.
Acknowledge the PullDock capabilities and privacy explanation to continue
